an10.172:1.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.172:1.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.172:1.5: idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an10.172:2.1: athakho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi
an10.172:2.2: idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:2.3: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.172:2.5: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.172:2.6: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti
an10.172:3.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahākaccāno satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ
an10.172:3.3: pahoti āyasmā mahākaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ
an10.172:3.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma
an10.172:3.5: yathā no āyasmā mahākaccāno byākarissati tathā naṃ dhāressāmāti
an10.172:4.1: atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākaccānena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
an10.172:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavocuṃ
an10.172:5.1: idaṃ kho no āvuso kaccāna bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:5.2: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.172:5.4: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.172:6.1: tesaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi
an10.172:6.2: idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:6.3: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca anattho ca veditabbo attho ca adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.172:6.5: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa udiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti
an10.172:7.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahākaccāno satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ
an10.172:7.3: pahoti āyasmā mahākaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ
an10.172:7.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma
an10.172:7.5: yathā no āyasmā mahākaccāno byākarissati tathā naṃ dhāressāmāti
an10.172:8.1: seyyathāpi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva mūlaṃ atikkamma khandhaṃ sākhāpalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya
an10.172:8.2: evaṃ sampadamidaṃ āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etamatthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha
an10.172:8.3: so hi āvuso bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammasāmī tathāgato
an10.172:8.4: soceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ tumhe bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha
an10.172:8.5: yathā no bhagavā byākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti
an10.172:9.1: addhāvuso kaccāna bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammasāmī tathāgato
an10.172:9.2: soceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ mayaṃ bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma
an10.172:9.3: yathā no bhagavā byākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma
an10.172:9.4: apicāyasmā mahākaccāno satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ
an10.172:9.5: pahoti āyasmā mahākaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ
an10.172:10.2: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahākaccānassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.172:11.1: yaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:11.2: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca anattho ca veditabbo attho ca adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.172:12.1: katamo cāvuso adhammo katamo ca dhammo
an10.172:12.2: katamo ca anattho katamo ca attho
an10.172:12.5: ye ca pāṇātipātapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:12.6: pāṇātipātā veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:13.3: ye ca adinnādānapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:13.4: adinnādānā veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:14.3: ye ca kāmesu micchācārapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:14.4: kāmesu micchācārāveramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:15.3: ye ca musāvādapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:15.4: musāvādā veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:16.3: ye ca pisuṇā vācāpaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:16.4: pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:17.3: ye ca pharusavācāpaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:17.4: pharusāya vācāya veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:18.3: ye ca samphappalāpapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:18.4: samphappalāpā veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:19.3: ye ca abhijjhāpaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:19.4: anabhijjhāpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:20.3: ye ca byāpādapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:20.4: abyāpādapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:21.3: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.172:21.4: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:22.1: yaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:22.2: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca anattho ca veditabbo attho ca adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.172:22.4: imassapi kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi
an10.172:22.5: ākaṅkhamānā capana tumhe āvuso bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha
an10.172:22.6: yathā no bhagavā byākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.

an10.172:26.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma

an10.172:28.3: maṃ cepi tumhe bhikkhave upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha ahampicetaṃ evameva byākareyyaṃ yathātaṃ mahākaccānena byākataṃ
an10.172:28.4: esoceva tassa attho evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
